About SculptSoft
We are a Team of Passionate People Eager to go an Extra Mile for you.
With a proven track record, SculptSoft is your trusted partner for advanced custom software development services. We combine deep industry expertise and the latest technologies to create tailored software solutions that improve business performance, streamline operations, and accelerate growth.
Leading Custom Software Development Company
Established in 2012, SculptSoft is a leading custom software development company dedicated to empowering businesses with the latest technology. Our team of 140+ experienced professionals specializes in creating tailored software applications that address the unique needs of our clients across various industries. With a focus on quality, scalability, and user experience, we leverage the latest technologies to deliver advanced services, including custom web app development, mobile app development, gen AI development, AI ML development, staff augmentation and offshore outsourcing. At SculptSoft, we believe in fostering long-term partnerships with our clients, helping them navigate the digital landscape and achieve their strategic goals through impactful software development.

Baby steps towards dream organization
Sculptsoft was a blurry image of our co-founders in 2011. With time they grabbed the opportunity to live their dream in 2012.
The Beginning
We established a solution-centric IT organization with a small team of 10 people in 2014.
Crossing the bridge of success
In 2020, With 70+ outstanding solutions delivered, we worked with multiple industries and 15+ retaining clients.

We are happy to share that we registered as a Private Limited company with an intelligent & highly qualified team of 120+ in 2022.
